title: References
seo_title: References - IMAA – Institute for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Alliances
body_html: Our participants have either worked at or joined the following companies after attending M&A trainings and courses by our Institute or faculty or after completing the M&A certificate. This is a selection of companies, some of them well-known. However our participants range from small and medium sized companies to global players and include state owned enterprises (SOE), sovereign wealth funds (SWF), private equity (PE), investment banking, government bodies, as well as non-governmental organizations (NGOs)

migration_notes: Source: the page's intro text, its 'Companies by Alphabetical Order:' heading, the logo wall (custom Elementor widget 'companies-imaa', 258 logos in the page's order) and the 'Contact Us' block. The page title widget is the page title here.
Headings: 'Companies by Alphabetical Order:' and 'Contact Us' were h3 in WordPress and are h2 here, because the page title is the page's h1; their text is unchanged.

Logos: the 258 files from the WordPress media library, downscaled to fit 320x160 px (never upscaled; PNG and JPEG kept, metadata removed) and stored in media/references/ under the company's WordPress slug. media[].source_url is each file's WordPress URL. On a CMS page they are Wagtail images in the 'Public website pages' collection, embedded with the rich-text image format 'logo'.

Alt text: 233 logos use their WordPress alt text verbatim ('<company> logo'). 25 logos have no alt text in WordPress; their alt text is the company's name from its WordPress company record followed by ' logo', the pattern of the other logos (media[].alt_source = 'wordpress-company-name').

FOR REVIEW (names as written in WordPress, not corrected): '3m', 'Allen Overy', 'Alvarez Marsal', 'CitiBank', 'CocaCola', 'Majid Al Futtain' and 'Accor Hotels' are the WordPress company names behind logos that had no alt text.

Contact Us: the e-mail address was Cloudflare-protected in the live HTML and decodes to info@imaa-institute.org. The six offices keep their city, country and phone link; the decorative country flags (images without alt text) are not migrated.
Order: the logos keep the live page's order, which is alphabetical with accented letters sorted as their base letter (for example 'ČEZ Group' among the C's, 'Österreichische Post' among the O's).
Not part of this migration: the mockup's References directory (region and industry filters, pagination, company pages, company consent) is new functionality.
SEO: seo_title is the WordPress (Yoast) title verbatim, including the Institute's site name; the WordPress page has no meta description, so search_description is empty.
